run_evolution_cli: run the openevolve CLI to start a TSP tour minimization evolution with an initial program directory
run_latest_checkpoint: find the latest checkpoint directory in a given path by scanning checkpoint numbered folders
run_evolution_async: run an openevolve evolution asynchronously and print the best program metrics to stdout
review_cli_function: review the click CLI function that configures and runs openevolve for TSP tour minimization
summarize_run_evolution: summarize the async run evolution function that executes openevolve and prints best program metrics
